name: Eel’s Tooth
short: A schematic for a battery-charging blade.
long: The best offense is a fully-charged battery. Every attack from this Unique blade restores one’s power pack by 5.

name: Leech’s Maw
short: A schematic for a set of power-draining dual blades.
long: A drained enemy is a helpless enemy. Every hit from these Unique dual blades drains a target of power.

name: The Angry Adder
short: A schematic for a rifle that fires poisonous rounds.
long: Sometimes, even a minor wound can kill. This Unique rifle is modified to do poison damage.

name: Hell-Fury Pistol
short: A schematic for a heavy pistol that causes burn buildup.
long: A special cocktail of magnesium and certain other elements can produce a very nasty, burning round. This Unique snub-nosed heavy pistol causes burn buildup on a hit.

name: Serpent’s Fang
short: A schematic for a poisoned Kindjal blade.
long: Intrigue amongst the Great Houses is a treacherous game. Poison often coats the blades of polite society. This Unique Kindjal causes poison damage.

name: The Hateful Barker
short: A schematic for an inaccurate but very damaging LMG.
long: Peak aggression is often the enemy of precision. This Unique LMG is very inaccurate but makes up for it with a 25% damage bonus.

name: Prescient Edge
short: A schematic for a rapier that causes bleed on a parry.
long: The edge of this blade is so sharp, its balance so precise, the wielder feels as if they know their opponent’s next move before they do. No attacker comes away unscathed. This Unique rapier causes bleed on an opponent with every successful parry.

name: Spitting Cobra
short: A schematic for a disruptor that causes poison buildup.
long: If at first your poison fails to slay — inundate, inundate, inundate. This Unique, assassin-modified disruptor causes poison buildup with every hit.

name: Blind Fury
short: A schematic for a scope-less rifle with faster reloads and firing.
long: Necessity is the mother of modification. This Unique rifle sacrifices its scope for slightly faster reload, slightly faster rate of fire, and holds 5 ammo.

name: Branding Blade
short: A schematic for a super-heated sword.
long: A special chemical treatment super heats the blade. Enemies who live tend to carry the scars with them forever after. This Unique sword causes burn buildup with every hit.

name: The Forge Boots
short: Schematic for a pair of boots hardened against heat.
long: Stock armor is made of hardened plasmeld. This Unique armor set is reinforced during the fabrication process - attaching minor heat dissipating components to every molecule within the plasmeld mass. This delivers increased heat resistance and a hard armor.

name: The Forge Pants
short: Schematic for a pair of pants hardened against heat.
long: Stock armor is made of hardened plasmeld. This Unique armor set is reinforced during the fabrication process - attaching minor heat dissipating components to every molecule within the plasmeld mass. This delivers increased heat resistance and a hard armor.

name: The Forge Gloves
short: Schematic for a pair of gloves hardened against heat.
long: Stock armor is made of hardened plasmeld. This Unique armor set is reinforced during the fabrication process - attaching minor heat dissipating components to every molecule within the plasmeld mass. This delivers increased heat resistance and a hard armor.

name: The Forge Helmet
short: Schematic for a helmet hardened against heat.
long: Stock armor is made of hardened plasmeld. This Unique armor set is reinforced during the fabrication process - attaching minor heat dissipating components to every molecule within the plasmeld mass. This delivers increased heat resistance and a hard armor.

name: The Forge Chestpiece
short: Schematic for a chestpiece hardened against heat.
long: Stock armor is made of hardened plasmeld. This Unique armor set is reinforced during the fabrication process - attaching minor heat dissipating components to every molecule within the plasmeld mass. This delivers increased heat resistance and a hard armor.

name: Circuit Gauntlets
short: A heavy armor gauntlet with optimized power usage.
long: A Unique heavy armor gauntlet that recon squads use to optimize power usage on connected Power Packs.

name: Power Harness
short: A Heavy chest armor with additional power reserves.
long: This Unique heavy chest armor comes with additional power reserves to assist House forces in mining and suspensor usage.

name: Bulwark Boots
short: A Unique reinforced heavy armor boots.
long: This Unique armor is handed out to the legal representatives of CHOAM, such as lawyers and tax collectors. Unfortunately the bright orange CHOAM logo tends to make them more of a target, despite the reinforcement.

name: Bulwark Leggings
short: A Unique reinforced heavy armor leggings.
long: This Unique armor is handed out to the legal representatives of CHOAM, such as lawyers and tax collectors. Unfortunately the bright orange CHOAM logo tends to make them more of a target, despite the reinforcement.

name: Bulwark Gloves
short: A Unique reinforced heavy armor gloves.
long: This Unique armor is handed out to the legal representatives of CHOAM, such as lawyers and tax collectors. Unfortunately the bright orange CHOAM logo tends to make them more of a target, despite the reinforcement.

name: Bulwark Helmet
short: A Unique reinforced heavy armor helmet.
long: This Unique armor is handed out to the legal representatives of CHOAM, such as lawyers and tax collectors. Unfortunately the bright orange CHOAM logo tends to make them more of a target, despite the reinforcement.

name: Bulwark Chest
short: A Unique reinforced heavy armor chest.
long: This Unique armor is handed out to the legal representatives of CHOAM, such as lawyers and tax collectors. Unfortunately the bright orange CHOAM logo tends to make them more of a target, despite the reinforcement.

name: Desert Garb
short: Light armor chest that is more breathable.
long: This Unique light chest armor is made with breathable material which allows one to better survive harsh desert climates.

name: Hook-claw Gloves
short: Light armor gloves that makes climbing less arduous and stamina draining.
long: These Unique light armor gloves assist House troops in climbing, making it less arduous and stamina draining.

name: Yueh's Reaper Gloves
short: A schematic for special gloves designed to maximize water gathering.
long: The treatment for these gloves was designed by the traitor, Dr Yueh. Originally he was searching for a way to repel blood from gloves during surgeries, but the applications of his water repellant treatment were wider than he imagined. Treated with a small amount of huf-huf oil, these Unique gloves repel water and prevent any additional dew from escaping while harvesting.

name: Idaho's Charge
short: Schematic for a jacket rigged with wires that aid suspensor usage.
long: This jacket was jury-rigged by Duncan Idaho to improve his suspensor power during aerial combat bouts. His famous knee charge relies on suspensors to give him additional range. This Unique jacket features a series of specially designed capacitors to optimize the flow of energy through power pack and suspensor belt.

name: Wayfinder Helm
short: A helmet with a boost to scanning range.
long: The electronics in this Unique helmet connect to hand-held scanners, boosting their scanning range.

name: Ix-core Leggings
short: Light leggings with reduced stamina drain while sprinting.
long: These Unique light leggings are equipped with a compression triggered mechanism which stimulates the leg muscles, reducing the stamina drain of dashing.

name: Tabr Softstep Boots
short: Schematic for a pair of boots that decrease vibrations.
long: Found abandoned throughout the former territories of the Fremen, these Unique boots are made of a strange type of soft leather. Each step in these boots seems to melt into the sand, reducing the vibrations that attract the worm. Sietch Tabr was one of the Fremen sietches that put up little to no resistance during the pogrom, instead melting away quietly.

name: Executor's Boots
short: Schematic for a pair of boots designed for CHOAM executors.
long: This Unique heavy armor has internal layers of reinforced metal to protect House troops from darts, however the bulk of this armor greatly increases stamina costs.

name: Executor's Pants
short: Schematic for a pair of pants designed for CHOAM executors.
long: This Unique heavy armor has internal layers of reinforced metal to protect House troops from darts, however the bulk of this armor greatly increases stamina costs.

name: Executor's Gauntlets
short: Schematic for a pair of gauntlets designed for CHOAM executors.
long: This Unique heavy armor has internal layers of reinforced metal to protect House troops from darts, however the bulk of this armor greatly increases stamina costs.

name: Executor's Helmet
short: Schematic for a helmet designed for CHOAM executors.
long: This Unique heavy armor has internal layers of reinforced metal to protect House troops from darts, however the bulk of this armor greatly increases stamina costs.

name: Executor's Chestpiece
short: Schematic for a chestpiece designed for CHOAM executors.
long: This Unique heavy armor has internal layers of reinforced metal to protect House troops from darts, however the bulk of this armor greatly increases stamina costs.

name: Pincushion Boots
short: Schematic for a pair of boots made to absorb dart impacts.
long: This Unique armor set uses an experimental plasmeld layer to absorb dart impacts. In the earliest versions, the darts would stick in the gel-like outer layer, leaving the wearer bristling with darts like a pincushion. Though that flaw has been perfected, the name persists.

name: Pincushion Pants
short: Schematic for a pair of pants made to absorb dart impacts.
long: This Unique armor set uses an experimental plasmeld layer to absorb dart impacts. In the earliest versions, the darts would stick in the gel-like outer layer, leaving the wearer bristling with darts like a pincushion. Though that flaw has been perfected, the name persists.

name: Pincushion Gauntlets
short: Schematic for a pair of gauntlets made to absorb dart impacts.
long: This Unique armor set uses an experimental plasmeld layer to absorb dart impacts. In the earliest versions, the darts would stick in the gel-like outer layer, leaving the wearer bristling with darts like a pincushion. Though that flaw has been perfected, the name persists.

name: Pincushion Helmet
short: Schematic for a pair of boots made to absorb dart impacts.
long: This Unique armor set uses an experimental plasmeld layer to absorb dart impacts. In the earliest versions, the darts would stick in the gel-like outer layer, leaving the wearer bristling with darts like a pincushion. Though that flaw has been perfected, the name persists.

name: Pincushion Chestpiece
short: Schematic for a chestpiece made to absorb dart impacts.
long: This Unique armor set uses an experimental plasmeld layer to absorb dart impacts. In the earliest versions, the darts would stick in the gel-like outer layer, leaving the wearer bristling with darts like a pincushion. Though that flaw has been perfected, the name persists.

name: Plastanium Pyrocket
short: A schematic for a heavily modified flamethrower.
long: The weapon’s designer had a known sadistic streak. This Unique customized flamethrower fires condensed balls of ignited incendiary gel. On impact, fireballs detonate, dealing damage in a large radius. The splashing gel clings to flesh, searing and bubbling skin and fat with intense heat.

name: Regis Disruptor Pistol
short: Schematic for a heavy disruptor pistol.
long: This Unique heavy pistol borrows technology from the fast firing-disruptor submachine gun, while adding a charging mechanism to fire shield-destabilizing darts.

name: Seethe
short: Schematic for a precision pistol for those who prioritize aim.
long: This Unique pistol comes with increased accuracy and bonus damage for headshots, but with a low capacity clip.

name: Feyd's Drinker
short: Schematic for an exasanguinating popularized by Feyd-Rautha Harkonnen.
long: Commonly used in his black-gloved main-hand during arena bouts, Feyd-Rautha Harkonnen had a small compartment designed that could deliver poison - though usually it was the white-gloved off-hand that carried the poisoned blade. Though most never knew of his treachery, this Unique kindjal became popular on Arrakis for the opposite reason, it was capable of stealing blood from enemies and storing it in the compartment.

name: Replica Pulse-knife
short: Schematic for a knife styled after those used in the Butlerian Jihad.
long:
During the Butlerian Jihad, pulse-blades were used to cut through the thinking machines and damage their electronics with pulses of deadly electricity. It is said that the secret of their making was lost during the ensuing centuries.

This Unique blade gives a small jolt of electrical energy to the palms when hitting an enemy — offering a small stamina boost. A far cry from the legendary weapons of the Butlerian Jihad.

name: Plasma Cannon
short: Schematic for a Vulcan gun that fires superheated darts.
long: Originally designed to fire a steady stream of blue orbs at hellish foes, this Unique plasma gun tears imps to shreds and rips Arch-viles and Cacodemons apart. Oh... I've just been informed this text is for DUNE not DOOM. Ignore me then.

name: Bashar's Command
short: Schematic for a Vulcan gun with expanded dart capacity.
long: This Unique machine gun is considered so effective at cowing the populace during wars, it is often placed on display in local population centers as a threat. However, the Sardaukar prefer not to carry such bulky weapons into conflict, and will only do so at a Bashar's Command.

name: Regis Tripleshot Repeating Rifle
short: Schematic for a non scoped Spitdart Rifle that fires tripleshots.
long: This Unique non-scoped Spitdart Rifle was developed with increased magazine capacity and fires poison-coated darts in a horizontal tripleshot pattern.

name: Dunewatcher
short: Schematic for an assassin's rifle that fires poisonous darts at long range.
long: Fremen warriors modified these Unique rifles and used them in their relentless guerilla campaign against the Harkonnen. A single Fremen could remain, near buried and practically invisible in the sand dunes beside a spice blow, awaiting their chance at Harkonnen prey. These warriors were called Dunewatchers.

name: The Ancient Way
short: Schematic for an ancient missile launcher with tracking missiles.
long: When Holtzman shields became widely available, the use of artillery in warfare dramatically reduced. During the Battle of Arrakeen, the Baron Harkonnen brought them back, using heavy rockets to seal Atreides soldiers in caves, thus avoiding the problem of Holtzman shields entirely. Since then, these Unique missile launchers have become widely sought after by Fremen and Imperial troops alike.

name: A Dart for Every Man
short: Schematic for a high-capacity disruptor for every caste.
long: This Unique disruptor has a small inscription beneath the barrel, beside the makers mark. It reads 'In honor of the Faufreluches — a dart for every man and for every man a dart.' No matter how often the schematics are modified, this inscription is always fabricated on the weapon.

name: Penetrator
short: Schematic for a scattergun with deep drilling darts.
long: This Unique scattergun fires drilling darts which penetrate slowly through a Holtzman shield and then continue drilling — causing gaping bleeding wounds to the enemy. When the inventor was asked about the juvenile name he simply replied 'I'm all about drilling through defenses and going deep. I also design weapons. Ask your mother.'

name: Regis Burst Drillshot
short: Schematic for a double barrel "anti-shield" shotgun with increased capacity that charges up to fire a burst of two burrow darts.
long: An increased capacity makes this Unique Drillshot the anti-shield weapon of choice. An added charge mechanism was added to the base FK7, powering up devastating 2-round bursts of burrow darts.

name: Ambition
short: A unique schematic.
long: A unique shotgun with an ambitious design that holds two slugs in each barrel to limit the downsides of these types of weapons.

name: Crew Chief’s Stillsuit Garment
short: Schematic for a lightweight stillsuit body that reduces the stamina cost of dashing.
long: It takes years of hard work to reach the rank of Guild Crew Chief. Most chiefs are well into their later years when they earn their promotion, and the wear and tear of a lifetime spent spice harvesting has taken its toll on their bodies. Investing in one of these Unique ultralight stillsuits is one way to make getting through a twelve hour shift a bit easier. Even those who are still strong and vigorous will benefit from wearing such a suit, as it significantly reduces the stamina cost of dashing.

name: Imperial Stillsuit Boots
short: Schematic for stillsuit boots designed for Imperial visitors.
long: This Unique stillsuit was designed by the finest tailors CHOAM has access to, and every detail has been considered for the comfort and cut. It is also highly armored, which makes it useful in combat. But regardless, the Imperium has never quite managed to replicate the elegant simplicity of Fremen technology.

name: Imperial Stillsuit Gloves
short: Schematic for stillsuit gloves designed for Imperial visitors.
long: This Unique stillsuit was designed by the finest tailors CHOAM has access to, and every detail has been considered for the comfort and cut. It is also highly armored, which makes it useful in combat. But regardless, the Imperium has never quite managed to replicate the elegant simplicity of Fremen technology.

name: Imperial Stillsuit Mask
short: Schematic for a stillsuit mask designed for Imperial visitors.
long: This Unique stillsuit was designed by the finest tailors CHOAM has access to, and every detail has been considered for the comfort and cut. It is also highly armored, which makes it useful in combat. But regardless, the Imperium has never quite managed to replicate the elegant simplicity of Fremen technology.

name: Imperial Stillsuit Garment
short: Schematic for a stillsuit garment designed for Imperial visitors.
long: This Unique stillsuit was designed by the finest tailors CHOAM has access to, and every detail has been considered for the comfort and cut. It is also highly armored, which makes it useful in combat. But regardless, the Imperium has never quite managed to replicate the elegant simplicity of Fremen technology.

name: Villari's Stillsuit Boots
short: Schematic for stillsuit boots designed for water retention.
long: After his ordeal in the Deep Desert, Keif Villari became an overnight hero to the members of the Miner's Guild. Cashing in on his fame, this Unique stillsuit is branded by CHOAM as 'the stillsuit to wear when you're stuck in the desert for forty days'. Villari receives a small royalty for each stillsuit purchased.

name: Villari's Stillsuit Gloves
short: Schematic for stillsuit gloves designed for water retention.
long: After his ordeal in the Deep Desert, Keif Villari became an overnight hero to the members of the Miner's Guild. Cashing in on his fame, this Unique stillsuit is branded by CHOAM as 'the stillsuit to wear when you're stuck in the desert for forty days'. Villari receives a small royalty for each stillsuit purchased.

name: Villari's Stillsuit Mask
short: Schematic for a stillsuit mask designed for water retention.
long: After his ordeal in the Deep Desert, Keif Villari became an overnight hero to the members of the Miner's Guild. Cashing in on his fame, this Unique stillsuit is branded by CHOAM as 'the stillsuit to wear when you're stuck in the desert for forty days'. Villari receives a small royalty for each stillsuit purchased.

name: Villari's Stillsuit Garment
short: Schematic for a stillsuit garment designed for water retention.
long: After his ordeal in the Deep Desert, Keif Villari became an overnight hero to the members of the Miner's Guild. Cashing in on his fame, this Unique stillsuit is branded by CHOAM as 'the stillsuit to wear when you're stuck in the desert for forty days'. Villari receives a small royalty for each stillsuit purchased.

name: Pardot's Hood
short: Schematic for a stillsuit hood of heat protective material.
long: This Unique hood is designed to reduce the harm caused by direct sunlight. The famous planetologist, Pardot Kynes, designed this hood for Fremen workers who were helping with his experiments. It has been soaked in the juice of the creosote bush — inhibiting sweating and reducing heat buildup.

name: Shaddam's Bladder
short: A schematic for a stillsuit garment that boats additional water storage.
long: This Unique stillsuit design was originally an extension to the Imperial stillsuit and was manufactured by sycophant in the case of a visit from the Emperor himself. With extra large thighpads and catchpockets, this stillsuit lets the wearer go for days without needing to use a toilet, something which has become a source of much amusement.

name: Energy Resistant Weave
short: A schematic for a garment augmentation
long: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which reduces energy damage taken, but increases poison damage taken.

name: Detoxifying Fabrics
short: A schematic for a garment augmentation
long: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which reduces poison damage taken, but increases energy damage taken.

name: Flame-resistant Fabrics
short: A schematic for a garment augmentation
long: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which reduces fire damage taken, but increases poison damage taken.

name: Radiation Absorbing Fabrics
short: A schematic for a garment augmentation
long: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which reduces radiation build up and fire damage taken, but increases blade and dart damage taken. This augmentation cannot be applied to Radiation Suits.

name: Radiation Shielded Latticing
short: A schematic for a garment augmentation
long: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which reduces radiation build up, but increases overall volume.

name: Energy Dispersing Padding
short: A schematic for a garment augmentation
long: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which reduces energy damage taken, but increases concussive damage taken.

name: Desert-tested Weave
short: A schematic for a garment augmentation
long: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which increases heat protection, but increases overall volume.

name: Curative-infused Padding
short: A schematic for a garment augmentation
long: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which reduces poison damage taken, but increases fire damage taken.

name: Salusan Vengeance
short: Schematic for a modified battle rifle that fires explosive darts.
long: When Salusa Secundus was reduced from a fertile planet to an irradiated wasteland of a planet, House Corrino swore vengeance on their enemies. This Unique battle rifle was created as a memory of that oath and the explosive darts that it fires are reminiscent of the fires that rained down on Salusa Secundus itself.

name: Experimental Lightning Gun
short: Schematic for an EMP rifle that disrupts shields.
long: An old Planetologist wisdom says: “The freaks of cyclonic storms are the rules of cyclonic storms.” In their hubris to harness the Coriolis storm, a team of scientists lost their lives in an Imperial Testing Station. This Unique rifle, a byproduct of those experiments, uses electrical power rather than standard ammunition. The EMP blasts disrupt shields.

name: Indara's Lullaby
short: Schematic for a modified battle rifle that fires bursts of darts.
long: When the War of Assassins came to Arrakis, Indara and her husband, Ardan, were stationed at a small Atreides outpost on the shield wall. As the relentless attacks of the Harkonnens continued, Ardan forced Indara to flee into a nearby cave system with their young child. Nobody knows why this Unique weapon is named for Indara - but there is speculation that she and her child still haunt the caves of the Deep Desert Shield Wall. This rifle fires a modified three-round burst, with the final dart in the burst dealing additional damage.

name: Cauterizer
short: Schematic for a modified dirk that burns as it cuts.
long: This Unique knife is a modified surgical tool that was developed for treating field injuries. It seals injuries as it cuts using a small cutteray to superheat the blade. Mostly useful for amputations and as desperate field surgeons discovered, setting your enemy on fire.

name: Burning Blades
short: A schematic for unique, heated blades that tear and scorch the flesh, leaving a screaming impression.
long: Designed by Masano of the Sandflies, these unique, heated blades both tear and scorch flesh, leaving a screaming impression.

name: Vaporizer
short: Schematic for an advanced flamethrower with a large nozzle.
long:
While artillery weapons and projectiles became deemphasized with the invention of the Holtzman shield, the humble flamethrower saw wider adoption in the military forces of the Imperium. Holtzman shields provide very little protection against being slowly cooked from the outside.

This Unique flamethrower has a higher gel capacity and more intense flame.

name: Halleck's Pick
short: Schematic for a sword that releases a poisonous mist on contact.
long: This Unique sword contains a series of toxin releasing nodules along the length of the blade. Gurney Halleck, renowned troubadour and mercenary, kept a similar blade by his side when performing for noble audiences. When a drunken noble once asked if he felt his music was bad enough that he needed a sword to defend it, Gurney replied: 'Nay, I fear not your wrath, but when your wives and daughters rush the stage — I'll need steel to keep my trousers fastened!'

name: Static Needle
short: Rapier that disrupts power supply of opponents.
long: This Unique rapier is utilized to shock and disrupt the power supplies of their opponents.

name: Perforator
short: Schematic for a modified scattergun that converts darts to shrapnel.
long: Thin spikes in the barrel mean that the darts fired from this Unique scattergun will break into multiple shrapnel pieces on impact, causing a bleeding effect on enemies. Another example of Sardaukar weaponry built to intimidate and oppress.

name: Shellburster
short: Schematic for a modified scattergun that fires molten darts.
long: This Unique scattergun was used during the Battle of Arrakeen. When Harkonnen troops charged the front gates of the palace, they were dismayed to find the shields still functional, despite being assured otherwise. A group of Atreides gunners used shellburst scatterguns to spread fire and chaos among the Harkonnen ranks, breaking them.

name: Way of the Misr
short: Schematic for a modified maula pistol with an automatic spring mechanism.
long: This Unique Maula pistol has a modified spring mechanism that automatically reloads darts without releasing trigger pressure. This model is older than any others, and seems to have been developed by the Fremen. It differs from the designs that integrate the modifications from Count Fenring.

name: Shishakli's Bite
short: Schematic for a modified Maula Pistol that shoots two darts at once in bursts.
long: A too-tight spring in the magazine coupled with a too-wide barrel make this Unique maula pistol fire two darts at the same time in bursts albeit with reduced accuracy. Manufacturers have labelled these obvious problems as "features".

name: Sardaukar Intimidator
short: Schematic for a modified Disruptor that uses heavy darts.
long: A Unique Disruptor with heavy darts doubleshots for added damage. What it lacks in rate of fire it makes up for the punches it throws.

name: Replica Pulse-sword
short: Schematic for a sword styled after those used in the Butlerian Jihad.
long:
During the Butlerian Jihad, pulse-swords were used to cut through the thinking machines and damage their electronics with pulses of deadly electricity. It is said that the secret of their making was lost during the ensuing centuries.

This Unique blade gives a small jolt of electrical energy to the palms when parrying an enemy - offering a small stamina boost. A far cry from the legendary swords of the Butlerian Jihad.

name: Spike Hilt Sword
short: Schematic for a sword that reduces the stamina cost of blocking and applies a bleed effect to attackers on a successful block.
long: This Unique sword is fashioned from shock-absorbing materials that reduce the strain of blocks and parries. It also includes a cluster of integrated plasteel shards near the hilt that can wound the blade hand of an attacker upon a successful block.

name: Precision Barrel Adjuster
short: A schematic for a ranged weapon augmentation
long: A schematic for an augmentation which increases the accuracy of any ranged weapon.

name: Energy Resistant Weave
short: A schematic for a garment augmentation
long: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which reduces energy damage taken, but increases poison damage taken.

name: Detoxifying Fabrics
short: A schematic for a garment augmentation
long: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which reduces poison damage taken, but increases energy damage taken.

name: Dart-proof Latticing
short: A schematic for a garment augmentation
long: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which reduces dart damage taken, but increases overall volume.

short: A schematic for a garment augmentation
long: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which reduces fire damage taken, but increases poison damage taken.

name: Blade-warding Weave
short: A schematic for a garment augmentation
long: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which reduces blade damage taken, but increases dart damage taken.

name: Radiation Absorbing Fabrics
short: A schematic for a garment augmentation
long: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which reduces radiation build up and fire damage taken, but increases blade and dart damage taken. This augmentation cannot be applied to Radiation Suits.

name: Radiation Shielded Latticing
short: A schematic for a garment augmentation
long: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which reduces radiation build up, but increases overall volume.

name: Concussive Dampening
short: A schematic for a garment augmentation
long: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which reduces concussive damage taken, but increases energy damage taken.

name: Concussive Redirection
short: A schematic for a garment augmentation
long: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which reduces concussive damage taken, but increases dart damage taken.

name: Woven Reinforcement
short: A schematic for a garment augmentation
long: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which reduces blade damage taken, but increases poison and fire damage taken.

name: Penetrative Reinforcement
short: A schematic for a garment augmentation
long: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which reduces dart damage taken, but increases blade damage taken.

name: Energy Dispersing Padding
short: A schematic for a garment augmentation
long: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which reduces energy damage taken, but increases concussive damage taken.

name: Garment Reinforcement
short: A schematic for a garment augmentation
long: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which increases armor value.

name: Desert-tested Weave
short: A schematic for a garment augmentation
long: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which increases heat protection, but increases overall volume.

name: Curative-infused Padding
short: A schematic for a garment augmentation
long: A schematic for an augmentation for garments which reduces poison damage taken, but increases fire damage taken.

name: Karpov 38 Pressurizer
short: A schematic for a Pyrocket augmentation
long: A schematic for a Karpov 38-specific augmentation that delays the release of fired darts in order to build up additional force, thus reducing the fire rate while increasing the damage output and accuracy.

name: Karpov 38 Dart Sprayer
short: A schematic for a Pyrocket augmentation
long: A schematic for a Karpov 38-specific augmentation that opts for less power behind each dart in order to fire more darts. This reduces the overall damage of each dart fired but increases the fire rate.

name: Karpov 38 Heavy Kit
short: A schematic for a Pyrocket augmentation
long: A schematic for a Karpov 38-specific augmentation that alters the magazine to hold more powerful darts but fewer of them, thus reducing the weapon's overall volume and magazine capacity while improving damage output.

name: Karpov 38 Focuser
short: A schematic for a Pyrocket augmentation
long: A schematic for a Karpov 38-specific augmentation which improves accuracy and reload times and reduces recoil, but the overall damage output is reduced.

name: Karpov 38 Precision Kit
short: A schematic for a Pyrocket augmentation
long: A schematic for a Karpov 38-specific augmentation which focuses more on dealing critical damage to weak spots en-masse, thus increasing magazine capacity, headshot damage, and overall volume while reducing accuracy.

name: Karpov 38 Sniper Barrel
short: A schematic for a Karpov 38 augmentation
long: A schematic for a Karpov 38-specific augmentation which increases range and accuracy but reduces reload speed.

name: Pyrocket Decimator
short: A schematic for a Pyrocket augmentation
long: A schematic for a Pyrocket-specific augmentation which offers a massive bonus to shield damage but reduces magazine size and accuracy.

name: Flamethrower Decimator
short: A schematic for a Flamethrower augmentation
long: A schematic for a Flamethrower-specific augmentation which offers a massive bonus to shield damage but reduces the rate of fire.

name: Rafiq Snubnose Marksman
short: A schematic for a Rafiq Snubnose augmentation
long: A schematic for a Rafiq Snubnose-specific augmentation which grants a significant bonus to range and some added recoil control — but reduces magazine size.

name: VULCAN GAU-92 Accelerator
short: A schematic for a VULCAN GAU-92 augmentation
long: A schematic for a VULCAN GAU-92-specific augmentation which increases accuracy, recoil control, and reload speed at the cost of its shield damaging capabilities.
